prompt: Create a vertical dark fantasy oil painting of an ancient Egyptian high priestess standing on a stone temple terrace at night beneath an enormous full moon. The central subject is an Egyptian moon priestess, shown full body in a regal three-quarter pose, wearing a flowing ivory linen gown with translucent drapery, a deep black and burgundy front panel embroidered with gold celestial symbols, ornate gold collar, bracelets, belt ornaments, dangling beads, and a radiant circular halo-like headdress. She has long black braided hair streaming in the wind, sharp eyeliner, calm authoritative expression, and she looks toward the right. In her left hand she holds a shallow bronze incense bowl emitting curling white smoke; in her right hand she raises a slender ritual wand or stylus. Surround her with exactly four visible supernatural or ritual figures/creatures: one dark ibis-headed robed figure on the left holding a scale or ritual object, one translucent white veiled spirit facing her on the right, one tall faceless black-robed specter behind the spirit, and one small sacred bull statue or living bull near the lower right. Add exactly three major foreground ritual objects: a large antique celestial globe/orrery with brass rings at lower left, a square dark pedestal with a small gold vessel beside it, and a bronze fire brazier at lower right with flame and smoke. Background: monumental Egyptian architecture, red temple pylons, desert plants, steps, faint city silhouettes, smoky torchlight, and a star-filled indigo sky. The huge moon dominates the upper center and is overlaid with fine golden astrological diagrams, rings, arcs, constellation lines, crosshair geometry, tiny stars, crescent moon motifs, and hanging bead-like ornaments. Visual style: highly detailed painterly illustration, romantic symbolist fantasy, Art Nouveau and occult astronomy influence, muted indigo, charcoal, warm gold, ivory, and ember red palette, dramatic moon backlighting, soft atmospheric haze, intricate gold linework, textured canvas brushstrokes, cinematic composition, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的暗黑奇幻油画，描绘一位古埃及大祭司在夜晚的石质神庙露台上，置身于巨大的满月之下。中心主体为 一位埃及月亮女祭司，全身像，呈现高贵的四分之三侧面姿态，身着飘逸的象牙白亚麻长袍，配有半透明的垂坠感面料，前襟为深黑色与酒红色拼接，绣有金色天体符号，佩戴华丽的金色项圈、手镯、腰带装饰、垂坠珠饰以及光芒四射的环形头饰。她拥有 随风飘动的长黑辫发，画着精致的眼线，神情冷静而威严，目光望向右侧。左手持有一个浅口青铜香炉，冒出袅袅白烟；右手举起一根细长的仪式权杖或手写笔。在她周围环绕着四位清晰可见的超自然或仪式人物/生物：左侧是一位身穿长袍、长着朱鹭头的黑暗形象，手持天平或仪式用品；右侧是一位面向她的半透明白色面纱灵体；灵体后方是一位高大的无面黑袍幽灵；右下方是一尊神圣的公牛雕像或活体公牛。前景中加入三个主要的仪式物品：左下方是一个带有黄铜圆环的大型古董天球仪/太阳系仪，旁边是一个方形深色底座及一个小金器，右下方是一个带有火焰与烟雾的青铜火盆。背景：宏伟的埃及建筑、红色神庙塔门、沙漠植物、台阶、隐约的城市剪影、烟雾缭绕的火把光影以及星光璀璨的靛蓝色天空。巨大的月亮占据画面上方中心，上面叠加着精细的金色占星图、圆环、弧线、星座连线、十字准线几何图形、微小星辰、新月图案以及悬挂的珠状装饰。视觉风格：高度细腻的绘画插画，浪漫主义象征派奇幻，受新艺术运动与神秘天文学影响，色调为柔和的靛蓝、炭灰、暖金、象牙白与余烬红，戏剧性的月光逆光效果，柔和的大气朦胧感，复杂的金色线条，纹理感画布笔触，电影级构图，无文字，无水印。
